pass_a_gloss: Comfort abounding; acceptable season; triumph; ministry commended in paradoxes.
pass_b_english: 'As the sufferings of Christ abound, so our comfort.' (2 Corinthians 1:5–7) 'The present season is acceptable; behold, now the day of salvation.' (Isaiah 49:8) Triumph with Christ, who 'stripped principalities and authorities, triumphed over them.' (Colossians 2:15) Commend yourselves as God's ministers: 'in much patience, in afflictions, necessities, distresses, stripes, prisons, tumults, labors, watchings, fastings; in pureness, knowledge, longsuffering, kindness, holy spirit, love unfeigned, word of truth, power of God; through arms of righteousness right and left; through glory and dishonor, evil report and good' (2 Corinthians 6:3–10) — 'as dying, and behold we live; as chastened, not killed; as sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; as poor, making many rich; as having nothing, possessing all.'
